metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares proven exercises designed to help you recover quickly from a neck injury.

This easy-to-follow video demonstrates exercises that help stretch and strengthen the neck for fast, long-lasting relief after a neck injury.

For best results, try all of the exercises and continue doing the ones that provide the most relief.

Watch now and take the first step toward healing your neck injury!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:33 Tight Muscle Release
2:56 Stretching Exercise 1
4:59 Stretching Exercise 2
7:39 Decompression Exercise
9:55 Strengthening Exercise
